name: client-help-portal
description: Consultant / client help portal with screen-sharing calls, recording, transcripts and summaries.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @help/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @help/api" "npm run dev -w @help/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @help/shared && npm run build -w @help/web && npm run build -w @help/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @help/web && npm run typecheck -w @help/api
